sources.title: Common Workflow Language 1.2 workflow specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Snakemake：相依路徑、資源上限與可實現工期
related.titleEn: Snakemake: dependency paths, resource limits and feasible makespan
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：輸出可追溯到唯一輸入，缺測狀態與物理零值分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Every result traces to one input, and missing observations remain distinct from physical zeros.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Snakemake：相依路徑、資源上限與可實現工期」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付 DAG、兩組槽時間表、關鍵路徑與宣告資源稽核。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Snakemake: dependency paths, resource limits and feasible makespan using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the DAG, slot timelines for both cases, critical-path analysis and a declared-versus-observed resource audit supporting the makespan comparison.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐材料列四溫度，給每個 tuple 穩定識別碼；獨立以集合大小檢查重複與缺漏。
時間零啟動 A、B；四秒啟動 C，六秒啟動 D，十一秒啟動 E，逐段計槽數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: List four temperatures under each material and assign a stable identifier to each tuple. Independently inspect set cardinality and membership, ensuring duplicated labels cannot make an incomplete set appear to contain twelve valid cases.
Start A and B at zero, C at four, D at six and E at eleven. Check slot occupancy across each interval and identify B-D-E as the limiting dependency chain.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NAS NPB：先驗證結果再比較有效執行時間
related.titleEn: NAS NPB: verification gates before timing comparisons
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：輸出可追溯到唯一輸入，缺測狀態與物理零值分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Every result traces to one input, and missing observations remain distinct from physical zeros.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAS NPB：先驗證結果再比較有效執行時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付run-register.csv、驗證原文、可比較群組與排除理由；另外列CPU數、執行緒、編譯器版本與計時邊界，供另一位學徒重新篩選。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NAS NPB: verification gates before timing comparisons using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a run register, original verification messages, comparable groups and rejection reasons. Include process count, threads, compiler revision and timing boundaries so another learner can rebuild the eligible set independently.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐材料列四溫度，給每個 tuple 穩定識別碼；獨立以集合大小檢查重複與缺漏。
建立四筆候選紀錄，保留3秒失敗資料；分開記錄exit code、verification狀態及計時是否完整，避免以單一success布林覆蓋三者。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: List four temperatures under each material and assign a stable identifier to each tuple. Independently inspect set cardinality and membership, ensuring duplicated labels cannot make an incomplete set appear to contain twelve valid cases.

Create the four candidate records, including the failed 3-second observation. Record exit status, numerical verification and completeness of the timed interval separately so that one success flag cannot erase their different meanings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighboring and cross-group cases by model, measurable outcome, and transferable verification method.
